text:
Maya (CSM): @Jun quick heads-up — Cobalt (trial account) just sent a vendor questionnaire asking for a compact evidence pack: SOC2 scope/controls mapping, DPA signoff page, KMS ARNs, data residency diagram, and access logs for the last 90 days. They want it attached to the vendor portal by EOD tomorrow. 
Jun (Solutions): Got it. Which logs precisely? App-level request logs, infra/Audit logs, or both?
Maya (CSM): They explicitly called out access logs + admin console audit events. Also asked about key rotation cadence and whether embeddings are stored persistently.
Priya (Security): Embeddings are not stored persistently for hosted evals by default; for dedicated/private we note customer-controlled storage. I'll confirm with Logging team for retention windows.
Jun (Solutions): I can export console audit events and admin auth logs. For access logs we use `audit-logs-*` in Splunk. Quick query I'll run: `index=audit* earliest=-90d@d | where event_type in ("auth", "admin_console", "token_grant")` — should give what they want.
Tom (Customer Success): @Maya should we include a short readme for Cobalt that maps each questionnaire ask to the attached artifact? makes downstream review easier.
Maya (CSM): Yes please. A two-pager mapping table is ideal. Jun, can you drop the raw exports into the compliance bucket and leave a note on retention?
Jun (Solutions): Will do. I'll upload to `s3://redwood-compliance-exports/cobalt/1720054321/` and set ACL to restricted. Example policy snippet I'll attach:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/compliance-reader"}, "Action": "s3:GetObject", "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-compliance-exports/cobalt/*"}
  ]
}
```
Maya (CSM): Nice — include the KMS key ARN used to encrypt that bucket and the rotation schedule.
Priya (Security): KMS key is `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abc-rotation-key`. Rotation is annually by policy; automated rotation enabled. I'll prepare a short statement for the DPA response.
Maya (CSM): Also they asked for the SOC2 scope doc — do we have a current mapping of services in-scope for Redwood hosted inference?
Jun (Solutions): Yes — I'll export the latest SOC2 scope spreadsheet and highlight inference runtime, console, and billing. Will add a note about dedicated/private exclusions.
Tom (Customer Success): Can we confirm data residency for their region? Cobalt needs EU-only processing.
Priya (Security): For hosted customers, EU region processing is available — we have eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 regions. For any EU-only SLA we need them on Dedicated or Private; I'll add that caveat in the readme.
Maya (CSM): Great. Plan: Jun exports logs + scope sheet, Priya provides KMS/rotation + residency note, I’ll assemble readme and upload to vendor portal. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Jun (Solutions): Starting exports now. ETA for uploads ~ 6 hours.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the compliance statement and paste here for review in ~2 hours.
compliance-bot: Reminder: attach PII redaction checklist before sharing logs externally. See https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/pii-checklist
Maya (CSM): Thanks @compliance-bot — Jun can you run the quick PII scan before export? small script: `python tools/pii_scan.py --path /tmp/export.json --redact true`
Jun (Solutions): Yep. Will run scan and redact before upload.
Tom (Customer Success): Thanks team — looping in customer success lead if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): I'll post a short summary in the Cobalt account record once done. Keep me posted on any blockers.
Jun (Solutions): No blockers so far. Will ping if upload fails.
Priya (Security): Will @mention legal if any DPA clause needs negotiation.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll check back after Jun uploads and then submit to the portal. :rocket:
